records.description: An inland municipality in eastern Aklan, formerly called Jemino and renamed in honor of Senator Jose Altavas. Local tourism materials highlight its upland landscape, waterfalls and caves. The town’s January Santo Niño celebration is tied to a local armistice observance. Outside the town center, Barangay Talon has waterfalls and caves, while Tinagong Dagat lies along the boundary with Batan. Altavas is also associated with toasted rice cakes and nito handicrafts.
